dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Plans of Anchorages between Borneo & New Guinea
dct_alternative_sm: Plans of Anchorages between Borneo & New Guinea
dct_description_sm: Reproduced by the U. S. Hydrographic Office ; Published at the Admiralty March 8, 1866, under the Superintendence of Captn. G. H. Richards, R. N. Hydrographer.
Relief shown by form lines, spot heights; depths by soundings.
Includes conversion and Tidal Information tables.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, drainage, marshland, buildings.
"Emergency reproduction of B. A. chart - Dec. 1942."

Chart 1. Bula Bay -- Chart 2. Namlea Road -- Chart 3. Kaibobo Road -- Chart 4. Saparua Bay -- Chart 5. Nalahia Bay -- Chart 6. Kisa Laut Road -- Chart 7. Tehoru Road -- Chart 8. Kayeli Bay -- Chart 9. Kawa Anchorage -- Chart 10. Asaudi Road.
